name: Advance Lifestyles Limited
summary: Advance Lifestyles Limited (ADVLIFE.BO) operates in two main sectors: textile commerce and property development. The company's efforts in real estate primarily concentrate on constructing significant residential and commercial projects. Its operational structure comprises two key divisions: the Textile Mill segment and the Real Estate/Property Project segment. Founded on August 18, 1988, the firm maintains its head office in Ahmedabad, India.
